meta.description: Eight eICU hospitals, two drawn from each of four absolute size bands, so the federation contains real 'expert' sites and real small ones by construction. Replaces the quantile-binned standard_8 (whose bin edges float with the distribution, so it can promise neither) and the explicit-id rare8_v1 (all >= 642 patients).
meta.population: 208 hospitals / 143577 patients in eICU CRD 2.0 patient.csv; 170 clear the 100-patient floor
meta.sizing_method: distinct uniquepid per hospitalid in patient.csv, scaled by a calibration ratio. The generation task keeps only patients with >= 1 unit stay carrying a usable diagnosis code, so a raw csv count overshoots what the freeze job sees; the ratio corrects for that.
meta.calibration_source: median of task_n / csv_n over the 8 hospitals in rare8_v1.summary.json
meta.note: This file records WHICH hospitals and why. The 80/20 rare-code-stratified split they train on is frozen separately by freeze_cohort_split.py into strat8.json (gitignored, carries patient ids) plus strat8.summary.json (committed aggregates + sha256). The true post-task patient counts land in that summary; if one falls outside its band there, re-draw with another --seed.
